integrity: The attached checker tests finite instances independently by residue-graph shortest paths; the universal theorem is justified by the mathematical proof, not extrapolation. Earlier special-case formulas are credited.
scientific_limitations: Odd coefficients 3<=m<2^n and n>=3 only; ordinary Frobenius number only. Uses the published Apéry and monotone-weight results; independent mathematical audit is not performed. Priority against unindexed equivalences remains uncertain.
title: A binary-weight formula for all odd-parameter Proth semigroups
